title: The First Night
briefing: Dusk falls on Caleb's Hollow. You and your companions shelter in the old inn, church and house while waves of corpses claw their way from the graveyard and the tree line. Hold out until dawn — one dusk turn, five long nights, and the light returns.
victoryText: Dawn breaks. The wave subsides, leaving the village battered but standing. Among the rubble, a new ally emerges — another survivor drawn to your fight.
defeatText: The dead breach your defenses. Caleb's Hollow is overrun.

params.title: Darkness Falls
params.text: The sun dips below the treeline and the temperature drops. From the direction of the old graveyard, you hear the scraping of earth and the crack of coffin wood. They are coming.

params.title: The Witching Hour
params.text: The dead of night. The attacks intensify — they come from every side now, scratching at the walls and shutters. Hold the line. Dawn is still hours away.

spec.reason: You and your companions held out until dawn.

params.reason: You and your companions held out until dawn.

spec.reason: Dawn came too late — the village fell with you.
